# roadie_relationship_rule (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a Roadie relationship rule.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "roadie_relationship_rule" "ownership" {
  id = "rule-uuid-here"
}

output "rule_state" {
  value = data.roadie_relationship_rule.ownership.state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The UUID of the relationship rule.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `match_strategy` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `origin` (String)
- `reciprocal_relationship_type` (String)
- `relationship_type` (String)
- `source_datasource_id` (String)
- `source_field_expression` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `strategy` (String)
- `target_datasource_id` (String)
- `target_field_expression` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
